news.title: Linda Sue Vogt: 1948-2026
news.summary_en: Linda Sue Vogt, whose generosity and steadfast support helped expand educational opportunities for Saint Louis University students, died June 14 at her home in Sunset Hills. She was 78.

news.title: St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo to Perform on SLU's Quad Sept. 1
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University's quad will become center stage Sept. 1 as the St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo makes its campus debut with a free outdoor performance of Shakespeare's The Two Gentlemen of Verona, directed by Rebekah Scallet.
